subsystem: Prepared EQN simultaneous and polynomial solver kernels
implementation: Readable portable C99 formulas in native finite-decimal operation order; no ROM execution, instruction interpreter or host floating point

implemented_routines.name: prepared equation solver
implemented_routines.scope: Modes1/2 linear systems and3/4 quadratic/cubic; coefficient banking, rational recognition, leading normalization, partial work state and prepared cancellation checks through15658

implemented_routines.name: stable quadratic formula
implemented_routines.scope: Zero constant, repeated root, nonreal conjugate pair and positive discriminant cancellation-avoiding branch, native ordering and exact policy

implemented_routines.name: cubic discriminant preparation
implemented_routines.scope: Stored P/Q/H formulas, native finite operation order and d=0 quadratic reduction

implemented_routines.name: Cardano branch
implemented_routines.scope: Ordered square/cube roots, real root and conjugate pair, inequality real-only policy

implemented_routines.name: repeated cubic roots
implemented_routines.scope: Simple/repeated ordering, two distinct results or one triple root, retained duplicate scratch

implemented_routines.name: three-real cubic roots
implemented_routines.scope: Atan argument with signed pi/2 fallback, 2pi stepping, radian cosine plus special-result recognition, original result ordering

implemented_routines.name: fraction-preferred division selector
implemented_routines.scope: Plain decimal eligibility via native integer/fractional test; exact fraction packing or ordinary scalar divide

implemented_routines.name: post-solver numerical cleanup
implemented_routines.scope: Independent8724 cleanup of active complex roots; history/display/event callbacks are excluded

implemented_routines.name: dependent/inconsistent linear classification
implemented_routines.scope: Original2×2 zero tree and3×3 ordered determinant/minor tables; zero-pivot/error shortcuts, checked-product underflow and thirteen-digit cancellation suppression

gaps: Result bank transfer, history, display and equation editor/controller are separate subsystems
Physical timer/keyboard behavior is replaced by a prepared cancellation response
Malformed BCD/compact records and rich-reference headers outside scalar formats are unsupported
Full scalar-kernel scratch/register side effects are outside this named value/work-bank API
